title: LAUNCH dashboard dataset, version 1
description: The one file the RBM dashboard pages fetch. Every text a reader sees is given in English, French, Portuguese and Spanish. Fields not listed here may be added without a version change; pages must ignore fields they do not know. Renaming, removing or retyping a listed field is a breaking change and moves to v2/. scripts/build-dataset.js checks every build against this file.

generated_at.description: When this file was built (ISO 8601, UTC).

approved_at.description: When the change it publishes was approved: the approval date, or the time of a manual publish. Show this as 'last updated'.

approved_by.description: GitHub login of the approver, or of whoever clicked Publish now.

issue.description: Proposal issue number, for an approval.

reason.description: Why it was published, for a manual publish.

pipeline_commit.description: Commit of the private pipeline repo this was built from.

content_hash.description: contentHash of the English content (i18n/content.en.json) at that commit.

locales.description: The languages every text carries, English first. Files published before Spanish (es) was added have en, fr and pt only.

data_status.description: draft = compiled from public sources, pending verification. Pages should show a notice unless live.

last_updated.description: When the data itself was last changed (meta.lastUpdated).

stages.description: The eight pathway stages, in order. A product's stages[i] is its status at stages[i].

source.description: The kind of source behind the step, e.g. National medicines registers. A label, so it is translated.

yardstick.description: Optional. How long each stage is expected to take, compared on the page with the stage dates. Numbers only, nothing to translate.

wholeYears.description: Expected years from the first milestone to routine use.

expected.description: One entry per stage, same order as stages. null = the stage is not measured.

basis.description: published = a timeline someone publishes; estimate = LAUNCH's own working estimate, still to be agreed.

glossary.description: Term → definition. Terms (keys) stay as written; definitions are text.

status.description: Anything but verified must be shown with a warning, as the dashboard does.

mft.description: Only on level mft: what kind of MFT plan the source describes.

sources.description: Ids of the sources (in data.sources) that support this entry.

checked.description: Date the sources were last verified, YYYY-MM-DD.

note.description: Internal remark, e.g. the patient group the policy covers. Not translated.

treatmentPolicy.description: WHO World Malaria Report Annex 4B for the four dashboard medicines, as in data/treatment-policy.js. Each countries.*.name is text ({ en, fr, pt }; French and Portuguese from the Unicode CLDR, i18n/country-names.json); everything else is English and codes.

text.description: A text a reader sees, one key per language in locales. fr, pt and es fall back to the English where no translation exists yet. Read the page's own language, falling back to en; do not assume a fixed number of keys, since a language can be added without a version change.
